title: Gemstone Heist: The Shimmering Scheme
story: In the sleek surroundings of Diamond Depths Jewelry Emporium, it all began with a routine opening ceremony. A seemingly innocent event to unveil the newly acquired, one-of-a-kind, 100-carat 'Twilight Star' diamond. But little did we know, a cunning heist was planned amongst the sparkling display.
victim: Mr. Amos Stone, the enigmatic owner of Diamond Depths
crimeScene: The lavish opening of Diamond Depths Jewelry Emporium
forensicClue: Peculiar scratch on the velvet-lined display case near the Twilight Star diamond.
question: Who stole the Twilight Star diamond and how was the crime solved?
options: Option A: Sir Leo Whitmore (Scratch on the display case)
Option B: Miss Opal Ravenwood (Access card manipulation)
Option D: Countess Ella Vesperia (Audience distraction technique)
